values.summary: Add the smallest protocol-adapter client-auth/equivalent boundary and explicit Runtime control body limit, then validate with focused protocol/control tests and exact-head review.

steps.action: Patch protocol adapter security boundary and tests.
Patch Runtime control body bound and oversized-body tests.
Run focused validation, exact-head review, publish and shepherd PR.

invariants: No plaintext credentials or credential material in tracked artifacts.
No terminal closeout for #5664 until exact-head review confirms these blockers are resolved.
Keep changes bounded to Runtime v3 protocol/control security.
risks: mTLS changes can over-widen protocol API surface if not kept minimal.
Body-limit tests must prove the route boundary, not only helper parsing.
stop_conditions: Stop if the repair requires AWS or external infrastructure.
Stop if typed lifecycle cannot bind #5755 without hand editing generated state.
Stop if exact-head review finds an unresolved P1/P2 security blocker.
